summary: The completed captured native paired engineering preflight supports formal-launch readiness under the existing fresh lock/device/source gates, with no pair-specific blocker. It does not establish formal accuracy, gain, cold-process recovery, or broader scientific completion.

formal_admission_assessment.next_step: Existing separately reviewed normal launcher must perform its fresh admission under the GPU lock and initialize from initialization_reference, never these preflight weights.

gt_provenance.details: Targets are ScanRefer/ScanNet annotation IDs, object point masks and boxes; predictions qualify the extra training support but never manufacture the target. No formal evaluation occurred.

score_normalization.details: No reported formal score is normalized by model outputs. Native box loss divides by the matched-target count; the extra term uses actual batch size 8 and native (10 L_bbox + 2 L_giou)/7. Raw training losses and raw gate extrema are reported. Prediction softmax is the existing bbs ranking, not an accuracy normalization.

result_existence.details: All 8 captured files match intake byte/SHA records and transport base64; all 3 complete log tails match captured transport. Both receipt objects match embedded intake copies, both exits are zero, and diagnostics agree with receipts. Remote engineering checkpoints are rehash-checked in the captured observer; this reviewer did not load their payloads.

dead_code.details: The actual preflight calls normal TrainTester.get_loaders/get_model/get_optimizer/train_one_epoch and observes the existing _compute_loss; receipt values and log step lines corroborate two steps. Formal evaluate_one_epoch, its per-row diagnostics, and verify_native_replacement are not called by this preflight and supply no actual witness here.

scope.details: Exactly two native updates and 16 presented examples per arm, same seed and augmented batches; no full dataset replay, validation result, multi-GT runtime test, cold-process recovery, multi-seed statistics, or demonstrated gain.

eval_type.details: Dataset-provided ground truth is used for real native training. No formal evaluation was run.
eval_type.qualifier: Real-GT native training engineering preflight; formal evaluation absent.

Logs/protocols differ only in Span LR plus arm/output/provenance metadata; group LR=1e-5 versus 1e-6 for Span, with other groups unchanged.

Child Python is the established Python3.7/Torch1.10.2+cu111 environment with isolated source prepended; no install or new environment was run by this audit.

actual_initialization_full_state.details: Hash-checked strict official load at 1234 state entries; G installation gives 1271, G state delta 1072, support state delta 10, retained Span state yields full 1295. Both use retained Span SHA f9898c5dc7a5e97bf152421efc9072c23ef255618c64477a4bfacf996f2b3b19, preserve original trainability and frozen RoBERTa. Initial eval-mode blend arithmetic is checked against each arm own output; it is not formal E0 evaluation.

losses_and_gradient_chain.details: Unchanged native losses plus existing G semantic replacement and selected-support geometry. Extra mask supervision disabled. Each arm has 7 then 6 eligible extra rows, exactly 7 then 6 nonzero direct center/size locations, with asserted zero outside eligibility. Positive finite module total-loss norms and actual parameter changes are observed.

actual_two_updates_and_same_process_reco.details: Each arm completes two native optimizer/scheduler updates. Source asserts 820 populated optimizer states at step 2 and full model/optimizer/scheduler/Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG equality after same-process rebuild/load; receipts report full_recovery_exact. Scheduler uses normal 4583-step horizon, milestones 1287823/1562803, not a two-step horizon.

no_formal_accuracy_or_preflight_weight_r.details: All actual pair formal_accuracy/retained_metrics values are null and formal training was not started/admitted by this pair. Future normal controller excludes checkpoint_path and uses the same original initialization_reference, so these engineering weights do not become its startup state.

sole_A100_serial_process_closure.qualifier: Captured event-time closure; fresh lock/device checks remain the normal launcher responsibility.
sole_A100_serial_process_closure.details: Launch uses flock --no-fork on existing gpu0 lock; controller rechecks prior process absence, no compute PIDs and exactly one index-0 A100 with 40-45GB total before launching sequential child.wait arms. Completed captured status and both exits are zero. At 2026-10-14T02:00:53+08:00 observer records controller423242 and final child426457 absent. Equal-child process exit is proven by wait/exit/status, without a separate observer PID record.

findings.title: Captured runtime evidence, no fresh remote attestation
findings.detail: The audit rehashed 101 of 118 staged source files locally and all locally supplied primary captures. The 17 unavailable local source byte copies are listed individually in SOURCE_BINDINGS.json. Their sizes/SHA values remain captured remote bindings checked by the launch/controller source; the reviewer did not freshly read the remote environment, source tree, compiled kernels, datasets, original initialization checkpoint payloads, or engineering checkpoint payloads.

findings.title: No formal accuracy or performance comparison
findings.detail: Two batches, 16 presented examples per arm, four optimizer updates total, one seed (2027), no evaluation-loop call or E0/9508-example accuracy result. Constructing the 9508-row validation loader is not evaluation. Prior strategy hit counts in admission belong to that prior run. No gain, statistical robustness, optimizer-cause, or paper-innovation claim is supported.

findings.title: Recovery is same-process state equality only
findings.detail: Each arm saved unscored epoch-0 metadata after two updates, rebuilt the factory/optimizer/scheduler in that process, and compared complete saved states/RNGs. There was no cold process, replayed next update, restoration of dataloader position, or normal-loop resume. The normal main path explicitly rejects checkpoint resume and protocols say cold_resume_supported=false.

findings.title: Gradient attribution and multi-GT limits
findings.detail: Module values are total-loss hook norms before clipping, aggregated by broad module category. They do not isolate semantic versus geometric task-query branches, G correction, native losses, or extra-loss-only parameter gradients. The separate autograd diagnostic stops at center/size and only establishes the direct selected-output gradient support. Matched-other is zero in all captured batches; no multi-GT runtime behavior was exercised.

findings.title: Equal augmented batch hashes do not mean bit-identical computations
findings.detail: The recursive digest covers post-loader augmented batch data, including tensors, strings and labels. No second hash of the produced voxel tensors or full initial model state was captured. Both initializations are source/digest bound, but first-step total losses differ by 2.86102294921875e-6, so exact forward equality is not established. No cause for this tiny numerical difference is asserted.

findings.title: Review route provenance
findings.detail: Requested route: fresh native Codex gpt-6-astra with separate max reasoning. This agent has no attestable runtime identity/effort metadata; actual model and effort are UNATTESTED. Semantic review is same-family/provisional, not cross-family acceptance. Deterministic artifact checks are separately accepted only within their static/captured-byte scope.
